hero.text: The docker model CLI plugin for the Unraid Docker CLI. Models are pulled and served locally; the Model Runner container is deployed and managed from this page.

version.error: docker model version did not report a version.

network.intro: The runner publishes its API on this address. 0.0.0.0 reaches every interface, so other devices on the network can use it; 127.0.0.1 keeps it on the server.
network.apply_hint: A changed address takes effect when the runner is recreated; until then it keeps running on the old address.
network.security: The API has no authentication. Publish it on a trusted network only, or restrict port 12434 with a firewall.
network.fixed_port: The port is fixed at 12434, because the docker model CLI connects to that port on localhost.
network.saved_hint: Run Recreate runner to apply the address to the running container.

runner.intro: The runner is a container that serves the models. It is pulled on demand.
runner.hint: Install and stop run in the background and log to /var/log/docker-model-runner-*.log. The first install pulls an image of about 1 GB.
runner.stop_hint: Stop removes the runner container; the image and the model volume are kept.

models.empty: No models yet. Pull one with docker model pull ai/smollm2:360M-Q4_K_M.

install.hint: The same commands from a terminal:

notes.registry: docker model pull does not honour the registry-mirrors setting of daemon.json. On a restricted network pull through a proxy prefix, for example docker model pull gh-proxy.org/docker/ai/smollm2:360M-Q4_K_M.
notes.api: The runner API is not authenticated. This page publishes it on all interfaces by default; switch it to 127.0.0.1 above when only this server should reach it.

action.log_hint: See the WebGUI log for details.
action.install_cpu: The Model Runner is being installed in the background. The first start pulls the runner image, which takes a few minutes. Progress is logged to /var/log/docker-model-runner-install.log.
action.install_gpu: The Model Runner is being installed in the background. The runner image is pulled on first start and an NVIDIA or AMD GPU with container runtime support is required. Progress is logged to /var/log/docker-model-runner-install.log.
action.stop: The Model Runner is being stopped in the background. The container is removed; the image and the model volume are kept. Progress is logged to /var/log/docker-model-runner-stop.log.
action.uninstall: The Model Runner is being removed in the background. The runner image and the model volume are kept. Progress is logged to /var/log/docker-model-runner-uninstall.log.
action.reinstall: The Model Runner is being recreated in the background to apply the listen address. Progress is logged to /var/log/docker-model-runner-reinstall.log.
action.settings_saved: The listen address is saved as %s.
action.invalid_host: That is not a valid IPv4 or IPv6 address.
action.save_failed: The settings could not be written to %s.
action.cross_origin: The request did not come from the Unraid WebGUI.
action.bad_token: The request was rejected: its security token is missing or expired. Reload the page and try again.
action.not_installed: The docker model CLI plugin is not installed. Reinstall the plugin first.
action.could_not_start: The action could not be started. See %s for details.
